title: mdm.employee.appointment.changed.v1
description: An appointment's complete current state; the record ID is its UUIDv7. An appointment is a qualification instance that is never reused (security 04): a change of legal entity, unit or position ends it and makes a new one. Its start and end are this event's state changes. Also a record of the watermark stream's record read.

unit_id.description: the unit (mdm/org); its path is the org fact a grant bound to the appointment uses

note.description: a display field, changed in place
